title: Sync is not finished
subtitle: Sending to the repository is blocked until the conflicts are resolved. The project keeps working as usual.

progress.label: Files resolved: {{done}} of {{total}}
progress.ready: Everything is resolved. You can finish: the changes will be merged and sent to the repository.
progress.left: Left to decide: {{count}}. The "Finish and send" button turns on once everything is resolved.

conflictType.content: The same lines were changed both on your side and in the repository.
conflictType.fields: The same fields were changed both on your side and in the repository.
conflictType.deleted_by_us: You deleted this file, but it was changed in the repository.
conflictType.deleted_by_them: This file was deleted in the repository, but you changed it.
conflictType.add_add: A file with this name appeared both on your side and in the repository.
conflictType.binary: The file changed on both sides. It cannot be merged by parts.
conflictType.signature_group: The document signatures changed on both sides.
conflictType.case_collision: The file names differ only by letter case.
conflictType.invalid_result: The automatic merge produced an invalid file. Pick a version.

info.merged: The edits of both sides did not overlap, so the files were merged automatically.
info.take_theirs: Only {{author}} changed this file, so their version was taken.
info.delete: The file is deleted: both sides agreed, or nobody changed it.
info.binary_newest: Both sides changed the file. The newer version is kept and the other one is saved next to it.
info.fallback: The file was handled automatically, there is nothing to decide here.

auto.copy: The other version is saved as
auto.hint: Nothing to decide here: Studio merged these files by itself. Open a file to see what was done to it.

pane.select: Pick a file on the left.
pane.error: Could not load the file contents.

parts.truncated: The file is large, only a part is shown. The rest goes into the result unchanged.
parts.allDone: All parts of this file are resolved
parts.prevHint: Go to the previous unresolved part (Shift+N)
parts.nextHint: Go to the next unresolved part (N)
parts.fileDone: This file is fully resolved. Other files are left.

hunk.title: Conflict {{n}} of {{total}}
hunk.lineTheirs: Line number in the result if you take this version
hunk.base: As it was before the changes
hunk.customHint: Write what should stay in place of this conflict.
hunk.customMarkers: Conflict markers (<<<<<<<, >>>>>>>) are left in the text. Remove them.

manual.hint: Build the final text yourself. Conflict markers (<<<<<<<, >>>>>>>) must not stay in it.
manual.markers: Conflict markers are left in the text. Remove them to use this text.
manual.truncated: The file is too large to edit by hand here. Resolve it by parts instead.
manual.active: The file was edited manually: choosing by part is off until you go back.

diff.saving: Saving your choices to show the result…
diff.binary: This is a binary file, there is no line-by-line comparison.
diff.truncated: Only a part of the changes is shown.

hint.ours: What changed in your version compared with the original.
hint.theirs: What changed in the repository version compared with the original.
hint.result: How your file changes after the merge. Parts without a choice stay as yours.

deleted_by_them.mine: Keep the file with my changes
deleted_by_them.theirs: Delete the file, as in the repository

deleted_by_us.theirs: Bring the file back with the repository changes

signature_group.theirs: Take the signatures from the repository

case_collision.theirs: Take the file from the repository

apply.title: Applying your choices
apply.text: Merging the files and sending the result to the repository. This runs on the server, you do not need to keep the window open.
apply.doneText: Conflicts are resolved and the changes are sent. Opening the history…
apply.failedText: Something went wrong. Your choices are saved, you can try again.
apply.cancelledText: Nothing was sent. Your choices are saved, you can go back to the conflicts.
apply.pushFailedHint: The merge is already saved in the project, only sending it to the repository failed. There are no conflicts left: open the history and sync again.

abort.title: Cancel the merge?
abort.text: The project goes back to its state before syncing. Your edits are not lost: they are saved in the version "{{name}}".
abort.textPlain: The project goes back to its state before syncing. Your edits are not lost: they are already saved in the history.
abort.done: The merge is cancelled, the project stays as it was

none.title: No conflicts
none.text: The sync is already finished or the merge was cancelled. There is nothing to resolve.

notice.outdated: The project or the repository changed while you were resolving. The list is refreshed and your choices are kept where files did not change.
notice.restarted: New changes appeared in the repository while sending. The list is refreshed: check your choices and finish again.
notice.unresolved: Unresolved files left: {{count}}. They are marked in the list.
notice.saveFailed: Your choices were not saved on the server, so finishing is not possible yet. Try again.

fields.allDone: Every field in this file is resolved
fields.unionHint: The list will hold the values from both sides, without repeats.

auto.hint: The sides did not disagree here: only one of them changed the field, or both wrote the same value.

from.same: both sides have the same value

binary.explain: This kind of file cannot be merged by parts, so one version is kept as a whole.
binary.previewTheirs: Preview of the version from the repository
binary.noPreview: There is no preview for this kind of file
binary.tooBig: The file is large, so the preview is not loaded
binary.newestKeepsPlain: The version that was changed later stays.
binary.copySaved: If you keep the newer one, Studio saves the other version next to it under this name:

them.mine: The file stays in the project with your changes, and the deletion from the repository is not applied.
them.theirs: The file disappears from the project and your changes in it are not kept. Earlier versions stay in the history.

us.mine: The file stays deleted. The changes from the repository do not reach the project, but they stay in the history.
us.theirs: The file comes back to the project together with the changes from the repository.

signature_group.title: Signatures cannot be mixed
signature_group.text: A signature covers the document byte for byte, so one side's whole set is taken: the frozen PDF together with its signatures. The other side's set is removed from the project.

case_collision.title: The names differ only by letter case
case_collision.text: On macOS and Windows such names mean the same file, so both cannot stay in the project. Pick the one to keep.

template_missing_after_merge.title: This Studio version does not have the template
template_missing_after_merge.text: The merge will go through, but the project will open read-only afterwards: the template it needs is not here. The version from before the sync is saved, so you can go back to it.

signatures_stale.title: Signatures are out of date
signatures_stale.text: After the merge the document PDF will change while the signatures stay from the earlier version. They will have to be collected again.

unsafe_path.title: Some files were skipped
unsafe_path.text: The repository sent files with unsafe paths. We do not write them to disk, and the rest is merged as usual.

case_collision.title: File names match except for letter case
case_collision.text: On macOS and Windows such files cannot sit side by side. They need a decision.

frozen_documents.title: Frozen documents were changed
frozen_documents.text: Documents that have signatures were edited in the repository. Check that the signed versions are intact.

team_foreign_edit.title: Edits in someone else's part
team_foreign_edit.text: A teammate changed files assigned to another author.

template_missing.title: This Studio version does not have the template
template_missing.text: The project opens read-only until the template becomes available.

lfs_pointers.title: Large files are not downloaded
lfs_pointers.text: Some files live in Git LFS and are not downloaded yet. Studio treats them as placeholders.
